features.purpose: Keep one mounted Exchange shell across lenses and utilities.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Merged Stage 2/3 mobile Exchange composition and participant shell contracts.
features.authorizationImplications: No new authority; server-projected state remains authoritative.
features.uiImplications: Reference only; do not copy the TestRFx shell.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Existing shell regression, 390px, five locales, continuity.

features.purpose: Use Opportunities/RFx | Resources | Intelligence | Capabilities; keep Referrals in Account/Menu.
features.dataImplications: No migration beyond existing legacy-lens state migration.
features.uiImplications: Do not import donor route IDs or registry implementation.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Exact order, legacy-state migration, referral deep-link preservation.

features.purpose: Keep four market lenses plus Account/Menu utility.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Mobile lens navigation contract and ExistingWorkspaceFoundation.
features.authorizationImplications: Current server/runtime availability controls navigation action.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard, safe area, active state, no fifth lens.

features.purpose: Peek/mid/expanded result surface with accessible non-gesture controls.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Touch, keyboard, list scroll, state continuity.

features.uiImplications: Do not copy donor IDs; compare visual treatment only.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Exact four positions, disabled reasons, current permissions.

features.purpose: Synchronize focal record and associated organization without losing return state.
features.uiImplications: No donor store or record identity is portable.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Marker↔card↔detail parity; list-only records remain selectable.

features.purpose: Shared search surface with lens context and preserved state.
features.dataImplications: No donor saved-search rows migrate automatically.
features.authorizationImplications: Search results must already be authorized.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Bounded query, authorized results, URL/back-forward continuity.

features.purpose: Declutter translucent search/filter/map controls and thumb zones.
features.authorizationImplications: No change to device-location or geography authority.
features.uiImplications: Adapt styles and interaction density to current components.
features.acceptanceCriteria: 390px, contrast, focus, reduced motion, no duplicated chrome.

features.purpose: Single provider-neutral behavioral contract for map camera, clustering and list-only records.
features.authorizationImplications: Map state grants no geographic or record authority.
features.uiImplications: Behaviors may inform Mapbox implementation; provider code is excluded.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Mapbox canvas, privacy-safe points, list-only truth, selection continuity.

features.purpose: Offer licensed/configured map types without losing state.
features.authorizationImplications: Only configured/licensed Mapbox styles may be exposed.
features.uiImplications: Reauthor selector against Mapbox; do not copy OpenFreeMap URLs.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Style switch preserves camera, layers, selection, reduced motion.
